advanced-filter-description: Sefe se tswetseng pele se dumella ho ngola mola o nang le diopereita tsena: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgeo se sebediswa ho arola diopereita. O ka sefa dibaka tsohle tse ikgethileng ka mabitso le boleng ba tsona. Mohlala: Field1 == Value1. Ela hloko: Ha dibaka kapa boleng di na le dikgeo, di kenye ka hara matshwao a qotso a le mong. Mohlala: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ho tlola matshwao a taolo ka bonngwe (' \/), o ka sebedisa \. Mohlala: Field1 == I\'m. O ka kopanya maemo a mangata. Mohlala: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ka tlwaelo diopereita tsohle di tolokwa ho tloha ho le letshehadi ho ya ho le letona. Fetola tatelano ka masakana. Mohlala: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla le dibaka tsa mongolo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: E tsamaellana ha ho thehwa karete, kapa sehlooho kapa tlhaloso ya yona e fetotswe, mme mongolo o motjha o na le sena (ha ho na phapano lipakeng tsa ditlhaku tse kgolo le tse nyane).
header-logo-title: Kgutlela leqepheng la diboto tsa hao.
imported-member-no-account: Setho se kentsweng — ha ho akhaonto e tshwanang
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kgomaretsa JSON e ntshitsweng ho Kanboard: ntho e nang le "columns" (kapa mesebetsi e nang le column_name) le lenane la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete.
import-board-instruction-deck: Kgomaretsa JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto e nang le "stacks", stack ka nngwe e na le "cards"). Di-stack di fetoha manane mme dikarete di dula e le dikarete.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kgomaretsa JSON ya pokello ya work-packages ya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a fetoha manane mme diphuthelwana tsa mosebetsi di fetoha dikarete.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kgomaretsa lenane la JSON la mathata a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Mathata a fetoha dikarete tse hlophisitsweng mananeng a Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Kgomaretsa JSON e ntshitsweng ya mesebetsi ya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ho tswa ho Asana kapa GET /tasks). Mesebetsi e hlophiswa ka dikarolo (memberships); e phethilweng e ya ho Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kgomaretsa JSON e ntshitsweng ya lenane la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Mekgahlelo e fetoha manane mme dintho di fetoha dikarete.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretsa lenane la mesebetsi ea markdown (mokhoa oo lisebelisoa tsa markdown-kanban tse kang Obsidian Kanban li o sebelisang): lihlooho tsa "## Lebitso la lenane", ka lintho tsa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka tlase. Lihlooho li fetoha manane 'me lintho li fetoha likarete; le lenane la matshwao a dikulo le se nang mabokose a ho tshwaya le a kenngwa, e le dikarete tse sa phethwang.
import-board-instruction-leo: Manamisa sebopeho sa Leo (faele ea .leo). Likarolo tsa boemo bo holimo li fetoha manane, likarolo tse tlas'a tsona ka kotloloho li fetoha likarete, 'me mongolo oa karolo o fetoha tlhaloso ea karete. Likarolo tsa maemo a tebileng ho feta li fetoha manane a ho hlahloba. Likarolo tse tšoailoeng li kenngoa e le tse phethiloeng.
import-board-instruction-opml: Manamisa moralo wa OPML, jwalo ka ha Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq le mananeo a mang a meralo a o ntsha. Dintho tsa boemo bo hodimo di fetoha manane, tse ka tlasa tsona di fetoha dikarete tse nang le mongolo wa noutu e le tlhaloso, mme tse tebileng ho feta di fetoha manane a tlhahlobo. Dintho tse phethilweng di kenngwa di tshwailwe di phethilwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Manamisa faele ya Org mode, jwalo ka ha Emacs, Orgzly kapa Beorg e e ngola. Dihlooho tsa boemo bo hodimo di fetoha manane mme tsa boemo ba bobedi di fetoha dikarete. TODO le DONE, dintho tse tlang pele, ditheke, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE le CLOSED di a bolokwa, mme mabokose a ho tshwaya le dihlooho tse tebileng ho feta di fetoha manane a tlhahlobo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Beha faele ea todo.txt: mosebetsi o le mong moleng ka mong, joalokaha sesebelisoa sa todo.txt le lisebelisoa tse lumellanang le sona li ngola. Mesebetsi e phethiloeng ("x") e ea karolong e phethiloeng, +project le @context li fetoha lileibole, (A) e fetoha leibole ea bohlokoa, 'me due: le t: li fetoha matsatsi a ho qetela le a ho qala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Beha sephetho sa task export: lenane la JSON kapa mosebetsi o le mong moleng ka mong. Mesebetsi e phethilweng e ya ho Done, project le priority di fetoha dileibole, annotations e fetoha maikutlo, mme depends e fetoha ho itshetleha ka mesebetsi e thibelang.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntsha faele ya .boardarchive pokellong e peteditsweng mme o behe dikahare tsa board.jsonl ya boto, ka mola wa mofuta kapa ntle le wona. Thepa ya ho arola ka dihlopha ponong ya boto e fetoha manane, thepa e meng ya kgetho e fetoha dileibole, dikarolo tsa mongolo le mabokose a ho tshwaya di fetoha tlhaloso le lenane la ho hlahloba, mme maikutlo a bolokwa. Ditshwantsho le difaele tse hoketsweng ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Ho Todoist, bula projeke, kgetha lenane la ⋯ ka hodimo ka ho le letona, ebe Manage data > Export as CSV, mme o manamise faele ya CSV. Dikarolo di fetoha manane, mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, mesebetsi e menyenyane e fetoha lenane la tlhahlobo, dinoutu di fetoha ditshwaelo, mme @labels le bohlokwa ba p1 ho isa p3 di fetoha dileibole.
import-board-instruction-planner: Ho Microsoft Planner, bula moralo, kgetha lenane la ⋯ pela lebitso la wona, ebe Export as Excel (ho Planner ya kgale: Export plan to Excel), mme o kgethe faele eo ya .xlsx. Dihlopha di fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka batho ba e abetsweng, matsatsi, dileibole, lenane la tlhahlobo le tlhaloso; Progress, Priority le Completed By di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ho MeisterTask, tobetsa lebitso la projeke, kgetha Export project mme o ntshe CSV, ebe o e manamisa. Dikarolo di fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka dinoutu tsa yona, letsatsi la ho qetela, motho ya abetsweng le ditheke; mesebetsi e phethilweng e boloka letsatsi la yona la ho phethwa. CSV e ngolletsweng ho kenngwa ho MeisterTask le yona e a sebetsa.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ho Obsidian, bula faele ya boto ya Kanban e le Markdown (kapa bula faele ya .md lenaneong la ho hlophisa mongolo), ebe o e manamisa kaofela. Ditsela di fetoha manane a nang le meedi ya tsona ya dikarete, dikarete di boloka ditheke, matsatsi, bohlokwa, dikarolo le lenane la tlhahlobo, mme Archive e fetoha dikarete tse bolokilweng polokelong.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ho Linear, ntsha ditaba e le CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kapa ho ntsha ponong), ebe o manamisa CSV. Maemo a fetoha manane, dihlopha di fetoha ditsela, mme ditaba di fetoha dikarete tse nang le motho ya abetsweng, dileibole, matsatsi, taba ya motswadi, bohlokwa, tekanyo, projeke le potoloho.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ho TickTick, bula Settings, Account, Backup & Import mme o etse kopi ya polokeho, ebe o manamisa faele ya CSV. Lenane ka leng la TickTick le fetoha tsela mme dikholomo tsa lona di fetoha manane; mesebetsi e boloka ditheke, matsatsi, lenane la tlhahlobo, bohlokwa le mesebetsi e menyenyane.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ho ClickUp, ntsha mesebetsi e le CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kapa ho ntsha ponong ya List kapa Table ka dikholomo tsohle), ebe o manamisa CSV. Maemo a fetoha manane, manane a ClickUp a fetoha ditsela, mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete tse nang le mesebetsi e menyenyane, batho ba abetsweng, ditheke, matsatsi, bohlokwa le nako.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ho Nullboard, bula boto, kgetha Export this board... lenaneng la dikgetho, bula faele ya .nbx lenaneong la ho hlophisa mongolo mme o manamise tse ka hare. Manane a fetoha manane mme dinoutu di fetoha dikarete: mola wa pele wa noutu ke sehlooho sa karete mme e setseng ke tlhaloso ya yona. Noutu ya raw e fumana leibole ya raw. Ha faele e na le diboto tse mmalwa, ho kenngwa boto ya yona ya pele.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ho Kanri, bula Import & Export mme o kgethe Export individual board (kapa Export all data), ebe o manamisa faele ya .json. Dikholomo di fetoha manane mme dikarete di fetoha dikarete, ka tlhaloso, letsatsi la ho qetela, ditheke le mebala; mesebetsi ya karete e fetoha lenane la tlhahlobo. Ha ho ntshitswe data yohle, ho kenngwa boto ya pele.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ho Pivotal Tracker, bula thebo ya MORE ya projeke mme o kgethe Export CSV (kapa kgetha dipale mme o kgethe Bulk Actions, CSV), ebe o manamisa CSV. Boemo ka bong ba pale bo fetoha lenane mme dipale di fetoha dikarete, ka mofuta, dileibole, beng, mokopi, matsatsi, ditshwaelo, mesebetsi le dithibelo; Estimate e fetoha dintlha tsa pale mme dipotoloho di fetoha disprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ho Tasks.org, bula Settings, Backups mme o kgethe Export tasks, ebe o manamisa tse ka hare ho faele eo ya .json. Manane a fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka dinoutu, ditheke, matsatsi, ditshwaelo le mesebetsi e menyenyane; mesebetsi e phethilweng e boloka letsatsi la ho phethwa mme bohlokwa bo fetoha karolo e ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ho monday.com, bula lenane la dikgetho la boto, kgetha More actions le Export board to Excel (ka dintlafatso le dintho tse ka tlasa tse ding ha o rata), ebe o kgetha faele eo ya .xlsx. Kholomo ya Status e fetoha manane mme dihlopha di fetoha ditsela; batho, matsatsi, tatellano ya nako le ditheke di boloka dibaka tsa tsona, dikholomo tse ding di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng mme dintlafatso di fetoha ditshwaelo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ho Super Productivity, bula Settings, ebe Sync & Backup, kgetha Export Data mme o manamise tse ka hare ho faele ya sp-backup .json. Projeke ka nngwe e fetoha tsela mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete ho To Do, In Progress, Backlog kapa Done, ka dinoutu, ditheke, letsatsi la ho qetela, nako e sebedisitsweng le mesebetsi e menyenyane; mesebetsi e bolokilweng polokelong e fetoha dikarete tse bolokilweng polokelong.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ho Taiga, bula Admin > Project > Export mme o jarolle kopi ya data ya projeke (qala ka ho manolla faele ya .json.gz), ebe o manamisa JSON ya yona. Maemo a dipale tsa basebedisi a fetoha manane, dipale tsa basebedisi di fetoha dikarete tse nang le mesebetsi ya tsona e le mesebetsi e menyenyane, diepiki le ditaba di fumana ditsela tsa tsona, mme disprint, ditheke, ditshwaelo le ditshobotsi tse ikgethileng di tla le tsona. Diphuthelwana ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ho Vikunja, bula Settings, kgetha Data Export mme o jarolle faele ya .zip eo e o romellang yona, ebe o kgetha faele eo, kapa o manamisa data.json e ka hare. Dihlopha tsa Kanban di fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka dileibole, batho ba abetsweng, matsatsi, tlhaloso, manane a mesebetsi e le manane a tlhahlobo le ditshwaelo; bohlokwa, phesente e phethilweng le boemo ba ho phethwa di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng. Diphuthelwana ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ho Quire, bula lenane la dikgetho la projeke mme o kgethe Export CSV, ebe o manamisa CSV. Maemo a fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka mesebetsi e menyenyane e le dikarete tsa bana, batho ba abetsweng, ditheke e le dileibole, matsatsi a ho qala, a ho qetela le a ho phethwa, tlhaloso le bohlokwa e le karolo e ikgethileng. Ditshwaelo le diphuthelwana ha di yo ho CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ho Wrike, ntsha projeke kapa foldara ho Excel, kapa tlatsa thempleite ya Wrike ya ho kenya Excel, ebe o kgetha faele eo ya .xlsx. Mela ya difoldara le diprojeke e fetoha ditsela, Status e fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete, ka Key, mosebetsi wa motswadi, batho ba abetsweng, matsatsi a ho qala le ho fela, mesebetsi eo di itshetlehileng ka yona le tlhaloso; Priority, Duration le dikholomo tse ding di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ho Teamwork.com, tlatsa thempleite ya Excel ya ho kenya mesebetsi (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) mme o e boloke e le .xlsx, ebe o kgetha faele eo. Manane a mesebetsi a fetoha manane mme mesebetsi e fetoha dikarete; mosebetsi o qalang ka -, # kapa > o fetoha mosebetsi o monyenyane wa mosebetsi o ka hodima wona (--, ## kapa >> ke boemo bo le bong ho ya tlase ho feta). Batho ba abetsweng, matsatsi le ditheke di boloka dibaka tsa tsona; Priority, Estimated time le Complete di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ho Businessmap (eo pele e neng e le Kanbanize), bula Advanced Search, kgetha Configure results ho kgetha dikholomo, jarolla faele ya Excel, ebe o kgetha faele eo ya .xlsx. Dikholomo di balwa ka mabitso a tsona a Senyesemane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): haeba akhaonto ya hao e sebedisa puo e nngwe, qala ka ho fetolela mabitso a moleng wa dihlooho ho Senyesemane. Column e fetoha manane mme Lane e fetoha ditsela; beng, ditheke, mmala, matsatsi, ditshwaelo le mahokelo a motswadi di boloka dibaka tsa tsona, mme Priority, Size, Type le dikholomo tse ding di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ho Redmine, bula Issues ya projeke, kgetha Also available in: CSV botlaseng ba lenane, kgetha dikholomo (All columns, ka Description) mme o ntshe data, ebe o manamisa CSV. Redmine e reha dikholomo ka puo ya hao, kahoo beha puo ya hao ho Senyesemane ho My account pele o ntsha data. Boemo ka bong bo fetoha lenane mme ditaba di fetoha dikarete, ka tracker e le leibole, motho ya abetsweng, mongodi, matsatsi, mosebetsi wa motswadi le ditaba tse amanang; bohlokwa, sehlopha, mofuta o rerilweng, nako e hakantsweng, % Done le dikarolo tse ikgethileng di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ho Notion, bula polokelo ya data e le leqephe le felletseng, kgetha ••• le Export, kgetha Markdown & CSV, mme o kgethe faele ya .zip eo e e jarollang, kapa CSV e le nngwe ya polokelo ya data e ka hare ho yona, kapa o manamise CSV eo. Kholomo e bitswang Status e fetoha manane (ha e le siyo, ho sebediswa kholomo ya pele e shebahalang e le ya ho kgetha, mme tlaleho ya ho kenya e bolela hore ke efe); mela e fetoha dikarete ka sehlooho, ditheke e le dileibole, batho e le ditho, matsatsi, le mongolo wa leqephe e le tlhaloso; dikholomo tse ding di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng. Dikamano, ditshwantsho le diphuthelwana ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ho Plane, bula Workspace Settings, kgetha Exports, ntsha diprojeke e le JSON, CSV kapa Excel mme o jarolle faele ya .zip, ebe o kgetha faele eo, kapa faele e le nngwe e ka hare ho yona, kapa o manamise JSON kapa CSV. Maemo a fetoha manane, diprojeke di fetoha ditsela, mme ditaba di fetoha dikarete ka letshwao la tsona la boitsebiso, motswadi, batho ba abetsweng, dileibole, matsatsi, mahokelo le ditshwaelo; bohlokwa, tekanyo, potoloho le mojule di fetoha dikarolo tse ikgethileng. Data e ntshitsweng ke Plane ha e na ditlhaloso kapa diphuthelwana, kahoo ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-trello: Botong ya hao ya Trello, eya ho 'Menu', ebe 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', mme o kopitse mongolo o hlahisitsweng.
import-board-instruction-csv: Kgomaretsa CSV (boleng bo arotsweng ka dikoma) / TSV (boleng bo arotsweng ka dithebo).
import-board-instruction-jira: Manamisa JSON ya patlo ya ditaba tsa Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (ntle le fields e kgutlisa feela di-ID tsa ditaba). Projeke e kgolo e tla ka maqephe, le leng le le leng le na le nextPageToken bakeng sa le latelang: kenya ditaba tsa maqephe ohle lenaneng le le leng la "issues", kapa kenya leqephe ka leng e le boto ya lona ka Kenya diboto tse ngata. Ntho e lekanang ya { "issues": [...] } le yona e a sebetsa. Maemo a Jira a fetoha manane mme ditaba di fetoha dikarete. Ka boikgethelo kenyelletsa lenane la "automationRules" ho kenya melao.
import-board-instruction-excel: Kgetha buka ya mosebetsi ya .xlsx: tafole e nang le karete e le nngwe moleng ka mong (dikholomo tse kang Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, matsatsi le dikarolo tse ikgethileng), kapa buka ya mosebetsi e ntshitsweng ke WeKan, ho kenyeletswa e nang le boto ka nngwe leqepheng la yona. globalSearch-instructions-description: Diphuputso di ka kenyelletsa diopereita ho ntlafatsa patlo. Opereita e ngolwa ka lebitso le boleng bo arotsweng ke kolone. Mohlala, `list:Blocked` e lekanyetsa patlo dikareteng tse lenaneng le bitswang *Blocked*. globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - dikarete tse nang le leibole e tshwanang le *<color>* kapa *<name>

globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarete tsa boto e abetsweng sehlopha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarete tse lokelang ho phethwa matsatsing a fihlang ho *<n>* ho tloha jwale. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ e thathamisa dikarete tsohle tse fetilweng ke nako.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarete tse thehilweng matsatsi a *<n>* a fetileng kapa ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarete tse fetotsweng matsatsi a *<n>* a fetileng kapa ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - moo *<status>* e leng e nngwe ya tse latelang:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dikarete tsohle tse Polokelong le tse seng ho yona
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarete tse nang le letsatsi la pheletso
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarete tse dibotong tsa setjhaba feela
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - dikarete tse dibotong tsa poraefete feela
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - moo *<field>* e leng e nngwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kapa `__predicate_member__`. Ho beha `-` pele ho *<field>* ho batla ho se be teng ha boleng sebakeng seo (mohlala `has:-due` e batla dikarete tse se nang letsatsi la ho qetela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - moo *<sort-name>* e leng e nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kapa `__predicate_modified__`. Bakeng sa tlhophiso e theohang, beha `-` pele ho lebitso la tlhophiso.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - moo *<n>* e leng palo e felletseng e kgolo ho 0 e bontshang palo ya dikarete tse bontshwang leqepheng ka leng.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ho ka hlaloswa diopereita tse ngata.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Diopereita tse tshwanang di kopanngwa ka *OR*. Dikarete tse tshwanang le boemo bofe kapa bofe di a kgutliswa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e kgutlisa dikarete lenaneng lefe kapa lefe le bitswang *Blocked* kapa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Diopereita tse fapaneng di kopanngwa ka *AND*. Ho kgutliswa feela dikarete tse tshwanang le diopereita tsohle. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e kgutlisa feela dikarete lenaneng *Available* tse nang le leibole e *red*.

sandstorm-migration-description: Ha WeKan e sebetsa ka hara grain ya Sandstorm, polokelo ya yona ya kgale ya MongoDB 3 e fetisetswa ho FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ha e qala la pele, mme diphuthelwana le diavatar di fallisetswa ho tswa polokelong ya data ho ya didirectory tsa files/attachments le files/avatars tsa grain. Sena se bontsha hore na phetiso eo e atlehile le hore na difaele tsa kgale tse tala tsa polokelo ya MongoDB di ntse di sebedisa sebaka se sekae sa disk ka hara grain, mme se o dumella ho hlakola difaele tseo tse tala ho lokolla sebaka.

cards-loading-lazy-note: Ho kenya dikarete ka lazy ke teko: dipalo tsa dikarete le meedi ya WIP di nepahetse, empa dipono tsa Khalendara/Tafole/Gantt le kgetho ya tse ngata di bontsha feela dikarete tse seng di kentswe. Kenya diboto tse butsweng botjha ka mora ho fetola sena.

render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ha e butswe, dihokelo tsohle (dihokelo tsa markdown tse kang [label](url) le ditheke tse tala tsa HTML <a href>) di dula di bontshwa e le mongolo o sa tobetseheng mabaleng ohle a mongolo o ruileng (dihlooho tsa boto le karete, ditlhaloso, ditshwaelo, manane a tlhahlobo, jj.). Sena se thibela dihokelo tse kgelosang tse ka tobetsehang. Ka kamehla e timme, kahoo dihokelo di dula di tobetseha.
always-show-code-as-text: Kamehla bontsha khoutu yohle e le mongolo feela
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ha e butswe, mongolo o ruileng ha o bontshwe e le markdown kapa HTML: mohlodi kaofela o dula o bontshwa e le mongolo feela mabaleng ohle a mongolo o ruileng (dihlooho tsa boto le karete, ditlhaloso, ditshwaelo, manane a tlhahlobo, jj.). Sena se senola dikahare tse patilweng — ditshwaelo tsa HTML (<!-- -->), sepheo sa dihokelo tsa markdown, JavaScript le khoutu efe kapa efe — kahoo khoutu yohle e dula e bonahala, ha e tobetsehe ebile ha e sebetse. Ka kamehla e timme, kahoo markdown e bontshwa ka tlwaelo.
disable-all-import-description: Ha e butswe, dikarolo tsohle tsa ho kenya di timilwe: ho kenya boto ho tswa ho WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, hammoho le ho klona boto. Dikgetho tsa lenane la ho kenya di patilwe mme seva e hana kopo efe kapa efe ya ho kenya. Ka kamehla e timme.
disable-all-export-description: Ha e butswe, dikarolo tsohle tsa ho ntsha di timilwe: ho ntsha boto e le WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kapa ho ya NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le ho ntsha sephuthelwana se le seng. Dikgetho tsa lenane la ho ntsha di patilwe mme seva e hana kopo efe kapa efe ya ho ntsha. Ka kamehla e timme.
disable-import-avatars-description: Ha e butswe, diavatar (ditshwantsho tsa profaele ya mosebedisi) ha di kenngwe le ka mohla. Sena se akaretsa ho kenya WeKan JSON, ho kenya Trello le ho amahanya avatar ho tswa ho bafani ba boitsebiso ba kantle ha ho kenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Mabitso le data e nngwe di ntse di kenngwa; ke diavatar feela tse tlolwang. Ka kamehla e timme.
disable-export-avatars-description: Ha e butswe, diavatar (ditshwantsho tsa profaele ya mosebedisi) ha di kenyeletswe le ka mohla ha ho ntshuwa boto (WeKan JSON le CSV). Mabitso a basebedisi le data e nngwe di ntse di ntshuwa; ke diavatar feela tse siuwang. Ka kamehla e timme.
anonymize-import-users: Pata boitsebiso ba basebedisi ba kenngwang
anonymize-import-users-description: Ha e butswe, ho kenya boto ya WeKan JSON ho nkela lebitso la mosebedisi, lebitso le felletseng le ditlhaku tsa pele tsa mosebedisi e mong le e mong ya kenngwang sebaka ka disupa-palo (mosebedisi1, mosebedisi2, ...), ho lahla avatar ya hae, le ho ngola botjha ditshupo tsa @username (le mabala a kopilweng-ke / abetsweng-ke) ka hara dikahare tsa dikarete le ditshwaelo tse kenngwang. Ha ho boitsebiso ba nnete ba mosebedisi bo tswang botong ya mohlodi bo bolokwang. Lentswe "mosebedisi" le latela puo ya motho ya kenyang. Ka kamehla e timme.
anonymize-export-users: Pata boitsebiso ba basebedisi ba ntshuwang
anonymize-export-users-description: Ha e butswe, ho ntsha boto ho nkela lebitso la mosebedisi, lebitso le felletseng le ditlhaku tsa pele tsa mosebedisi e mong le e mong ya ntshuwang sebaka ka disupa-palo (mosebedisi1, mosebedisi2, ...), ho lahla avatar ya hae, le ho ngola botjha ditshupo tsa @username (le mabala a kopilweng-ke / abetsweng-ke) ka hara dikahare tsa dikarete le ditshwaelo. Faele e ntshuwang ha e nke boitsebiso ba nnete ba mosebedisi. Lentswe "mosebedisi" le latela puo ya motho ya ntshang. Ka kamehla e timme.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Na o netefatsa hore o batla ho pata boitsebiso ba akhaonto ena? Sena se nkela lebitso la mosebedisi, lebitso le felletseng le aterese ya imeile sebaka ka boleng bo sa bontsheng boitsebiso ka ho sa feleng, se tlosa setshwantsho sa mosebedisi mme se thibela ho kena. Ho fapana le ho hlakola, diboto, dikarete le ditshwaelo di boloka nalane ya tsona mme di ntse di bontsha akhaonto ena, empa boitsebiso ba yona bo patilwe. Ketso ena e ke ke ya etsollwa.
disable-activities-description: Ha e butswe, dikenyo tsa phepelo ya diketso ha di tlalehwe ebile ha di bontshwe kae kapa kae (bara e ka thoko ya boto le tab ya diketso tsa karete). Ha ho nalane ya hore na ke mang ya entseng eng e bolokwang. Ka kamehla e timme.
disable-notifications-description: Ha e butswe, WeKan ha e romele ditsebiso tsa ho shebella (ka hara app, imeile kapa ditshebeletso tse ding) bakeng sa ketso efe kapa efe. Diketso di ntse di ka tlalehwa (ntle le haeba le tsona di timilwe ka hodimo); ke ditsebiso feela tse thibelwang. Ka kamehla e timme.
disable-watch-description: Ha e butswe, karolo ya ho shebella e timilwe — basebedisi ba ke ke ba ingodisa dibotong, mananeng kapa dikareteng ho amohela ditsebiso, mme teko efe kapa efe ya ho fetola boemo ba ho shebella e a hanelwa. Ka kamehla e timme.
backup-description: Etsa bekapo ya Diphuthelwana, Diavatar le/kapa Data (dipokello tsohle tse thehilweng mongolong tseo e seng diphuthelwana kapa diavatar). .zip e phallela ka kotloloho polokelong e kgethilweng — ha ho faele ya nakwana — e le backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e nang le YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Dipolokelo tsa leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) di sebedisa mangolo a netefatso a hlophisitsweng ditabeng tsa tsona tsa polokelo.
backup-scope-description: Tsamaiso ena yohle ya WeKan, kapa Mokgatlo o le mong. Bekapo ya Mokgatlo e na le diboto tsa wona le ntho e nngwe le e nngwe ho tsona, ho kenyeletswa diphuthelwana tsa diboto tseo — empa ha e na diakhaonto tsa basebedisi kapa ditlhophiso tsa tsamaiso ena ya WeKan, hobane tseo di arolelanwa ke Mokgatlo o mong le o mong. Ho kgutlisetsa bekapo ya Mokgatlo ho ngola feela dibotong tseo Mokgatlo oo o leng monga tsona.
theme-override-all-tenants: Phetoho e sebetsang ho bahiri bohle
continuous-backup-description: E romela phetoho e nngwe le e nngwe ya polokelo ya data, diphuthelwana, diavatar le direkoto foldareng ka metsotswana e seng mekae, hore ho kgutlisetswe boemo ba nako efe kapa efe. E sebetsa mmoho le bekapo e hlophiseditsweng nako, e etsang dipolokelo tse felletseng.
continuous-backup-enabled: Sebedisa bekapo e tswelang pele ho seva ena
continuous-backup-target: Foldara ya moo ho yang (tsela e felletseng diskeng e nngwe, sebakeng se arolelanwang sa netweke kapa sebakeng se hoketsweng ka rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (ka nako ya nnete, phetoho e nngwe le e nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Maqephe a SQLite (maqephe a fetohileng nakong ka nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (lenaneo leo o ka kgethang ho le kenya)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ha ho enjene ya polokelo ya data e ka sebetsang ho seva ena
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Nako pakeng tsa ditlhahlobo tsa SQLite (metsotswana)
continuous-backup-base-every: Etsa bekapo ya motheo e ntjha ka mora (dihora)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faele ya senotlolo sa ho pata ka khoutu (tsela e felletseng ka ntle ho foldara ya moo ho yang; ditlhaku tse 64 tsa mokgwa wa dipalo o thehilweng ho 16 kapa polelo ya lekunutu e nang le bonyane ditlhaku tse 16). Boloka kopi: ntle le faele ena bekapo e ke ke ya kgutlisetswa.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Ha ho sebaka (foldareng ya moo ho yang feela)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foldara ka hara setshelo sa polokelo
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faele e ka tsamaiswang ya Litestream (tsela e felletseng)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faele ya polokelo ya data ya SQLite (e etswa pela bekapo, ha e ngole le ka mohla hodima faele e sebediswang)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebedisa polokelo ya data ya SQLite e hahilweng botjha ha sistimi e qala hape nakong e tlang (polokelo ya data ya kgale e nkelwang sebaka e tla bolokwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Kgutlisetsa moloko o kgethilweng boemong ba nako e kgethilweng? Bekapo e tswelang pele e tla ema nakwana ha ho ntse ho kgutlisetswa.
continuous-backup-saved: Ditlhophiso tsa bekapo e tswelang pele di bolokilwe
backup-restore-confirm: Kgutlisetsa bekapo e kgethilweng? Diphuthelwana/diavatar di ngolwa tsamaisong ya difaele mme data e ngolwa polokelong ya data ho ya ka mokgwa o kgethilweng.
gcs-key-filename: Tsela ya faele ya senotlolo sa akhaonto ya tshebeletso
gcs-key-filename-description: Boikgethelo: tsela ya faele ya senotlolo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tshebeletso seveng.
gcs-credentials: Mangolo a netefatso a akhaonto ya tshebeletso (JSON)
gcs-credentials-description: Boikgethelo: manamisa senotlolo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tshebeletso. Se tlohele se se na letho ho sebedisa faele ya senotlolo kapa mangolo a netefatso a kamehla.
gcs-permissions-note: Fa akhaonto ya tshebeletso ya WeKan phihlello ya ho bala/ngola baketeng: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bakete ya hao → Permissions → Grant access. Ho "New principals", manamisa imeile ya akhaonto ya tshebeletso — boleng ba "client_email" ho tswa senotlolo sa hao sa JSON — ebe o kgetha karolo ya "Storage Object Admin" mme o Boloke.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tlohela ho se na letho ho boloka boleng ba jwale.
azure-account-name-description: Lebitso la akhaonto ya hao ya Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Setshelo sa blob seo difaele di bolokwang ho sona.
gcs-project-id-description: ID ya projeke ya hao ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Lebitso la bakete ya Cloud Storage eo difaele di bolokwang ho yona.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tlohela ho se na letho (e sebedisa sebaka sa kgokelo sa sebaka se kgethilweng). E tsamaellanang le S3: URL ya Endpoint ho tswa khonsoleng ya hao ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bakete ya hao → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → lebitso la bakete ya hao (kapa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mosebedisi wa hao → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → kgetha mokgwa wa tshebediso wa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. E bontshwa e le 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sekerine se tshwanang le Access key ID; 'Secret access key' e bontshwa hang feela ha senotlolo se thehwa — se kopitse ka nako eo (kapa o jarolle .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya hao → lebitso le bontshwang hodimo (hape tlasa Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya hao → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya hao → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya hao → Data storage → Containers → setshelo sa hao (kapa + Container ho theha se setjha).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sekgethi sa projeke hodimo → ID ya projeke ya hao (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → lebitso la bakete ya hao (kapa Create ho e etsa).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Tsela seveng ya WeKan e yang faeleng ya senotlolo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tshebeletso e jarollotsweng (e thehilweng ka tlase). Sebedisa sena KAPA o manamise JSON lebaleng le ka tlase.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akhaonto ya hao ya tshebeletso → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (e jarolla faele). Manamisa dikahare tsa yona mona, kapa boloka faele mme o behe tsela ya yona ka hodimo.

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: E etsa ditlhahlobo le ditokiso tse felletseng tsa botshepehi ba data ya boto, ho kenyeletswa tatellano ya manane, maemo a dikarete le sebopeho sa ditsela.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration: Hlakola manane a se nang letho a iphetang
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: E hlakola manane a se nang letho a iphetang ka polokeho. E tlosa feela manane a se nang dikarete MME a nang le lenane le leng le nang le sehlooho se tshwanang le nang le dikarete.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: E fumana le ho kgutlisetsa dikarete le manane a hlokang swimlaneId kapa listId. E theha tsela ya 'Dikarete tse lahlehileng' ho etsa hore dintho tsohle tse lahlehileng di bonahale hape.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: E kgutlisetsa ditsela, manane le dikarete tsohle tse isitsweng polokelong. E lokisa swimlaneId kapa listId efe kapa efe e sieo ka boiketsetso ho etsa hore dintho di bonahale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: E fumana le ho lokisa manane a sieo kapa a senyehileng sebopehong sa boto.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: E ntjhafatsa di-URL tsa diavatar tsa ditho tsa boto hore di sebedise polokelo e nepahetseng mme e lokisa ditshupo tsa diavatar tse robehileng.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: E ntjhafatsa di-URL tsohle tsa diphuthelwana tsa difaele botong ena hore di sebedise polokelo e nepahetseng mme e lokisa ditshupo tsa difaele tse robehileng.
migrations-admin-only: Ke balaodi ba boto feela ba ka tsamaisang diphetiso
migrations-description: Tsamaisa ditlhahlobo le ditokiso tsa botshepehi ba data bakeng sa boto ena. Phetiso ka nngwe e ka tsamaiswa ka bonngwe.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Sena se tla etsa phetiso e felletseng ho hlahloba le ho lokisa botshepehi ba data ya boto. Sena se ka nka metsotso e mmalwa. Tswela pele?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Sena se tla qala ka ho fetolela manane afe kapa afe a arolelanweng ho ba manane a tsela ka nngwe, ebe se hlakola manane a se nang letho a nang le lenane le iphetang le nang le sehlooho se tshwanang le dikarete. Ho tla tloswa feela manane a se nang letho a sa hlokahaleng ka nnete. Tswela pele?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Sena se tla theha tsela ya 'Dikarete tse lahlehileng' mme se kgutlisetse dikarete le manane ohle a hlokang swimlaneId kapa listId. Sena se ama feela dintho tse sa iswang polokelong. Tswela pele?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Sena se tla kgutlisetsa ditsela, manane le dikarete TSOHLE tse isitsweng polokelong, se etse hore di bonahale hape. Dintho dife kapa dife tse hlokang di-ID di tla lokiswa ka boiketsetso. Sena ha se kgutlisetswe habonolo. Tswela pele?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Sena se tla fumana le ho lokisa manane a sieo kapa a senyehileng sebopehong sa boto. Tswela pele?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Sena se tla ntjhafatsa di-URL tsa diavatar tsa ditho tsa boto hore di sebedise polokelo e nepahetseng. Tswela pele?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Sena se tla ntjhafatsa di-URL tsohle tsa diphuthelwana tsa difaele botong ena hore di sebedise polokelo e nepahetseng. Tswela pele?

Matsatsi ke dihakanyo tse tswang mohatleng o ka hodimo wa kabo; dipalo ke boitlamo bo tswang mohatleng o ka tlase. Ho nahanwa hore lebelo la ho phethela mosebetsi le tla tshwana nakong e tlang; sena ha se tiisetso. Nako e telele ka ho fetisisa e lekilweng: matsatsi a 3,650. Ho emisa nakwana ho tshwara melaetsa e teng le e tlang; Ho tswela pele ho leka hape ho romela melaetsa e moleng hona jwale. Ho hlakola ho tlosa melaetsa e kentsweng moleng ho fihlela nakong ya kopo. Ha ho romela ho ntse ho sebetsa, leka hape kamora nakwana. Molaetsa o seng o qalile ho romelwa o ke ke wa busetswa morao, mme ho romela ho nang le sephetho se sa tiisehang ho ka phetwa. Ho hloleha ha ka ho sa feleng le melaetsa e fihletseng moedi wa ho leka hape di sala bakeng sa tlhahlobo. Ho leka hape melaetsa e hlolehileng ho qala potoloho e ntjha ya boiteko mme ho boloka ho emiswa ha nakwana ho seng ho le teng.

email-recovery-failed: Tshebetso ha e a ka ya tiiswa. Ntjhafatsa mola mme o leke ketso e tshwanang hape ha ho hlokahala.
email-recovery-superseded: Ketso e ntjha ya motsamaisi wa tshebetso e nkile sebaka sa kopo ena. Ho bontshwa boemo ba jwale ba mola.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Hlakola melaetsa yohle e moleng hona jwale bakeng sa moamohedi enwa? Dikahare tsa yona di tla tloswa mme di ke ke tsa kgutlisetswa. Melaetsa e metjha e entsweng kamora kopo ena e tla bolokwa.
email-recovery-retry: Leka hape ho romela melaetsa e hlolehileng
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Ho hanwa ha nakwana ke SMTP
email-failure-smtp-rejected: Ho hanwa ho sa feleng ke SMTP
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Netefatso ya boitsebiso ya poso e hloka tlhokomelo
email-failure-smtp-configuration: Dipeakanyo tsa poso di hloka tlhokomelo
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Moamohedi ha a fumanehe kapa akhaonto e thibetswe
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ho fihla ha molaetsa ha ho a kgona ho netefatswa; hlahloba pele o leka hape
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Rasiti ya ho fihla ha molaetsa ha e a kgona ho bolokwa
email-failure-delivery-failed: Ho romela kapa ho lokisa molaetsa ho hlolehile
email-failure-retry-limit: Moedi wa diteko tsa boiketsetso o fihletswe
sync-time-estimate-hint: Ditekanyo tsa nako di sebedisa dikarolo tsa dipalo tsa nako ya pele/e setseng tse thehilweng ha ho kenngwa Jira. Ho lokela ho ba le karolo e le nngwe feela e tsamaellanang botong ena. Diphetoho tsa lehae di hlahlojwa e le dikgohlano; boleng bo siyo mohloding bo a iphapanyetswa mme null e boletsweng ka ho hlaka e hlakola boleng.
sync-planning-hint: Potoloho ya Scrum le dintsho di amahanngwa feela ha Scrum e buletswe botong ena. Potoloho kapa ntsho e siyo e thehwa botong ena, ka matsatsi ao mohlodi o fanang ka ona; e seng e le teng e bapiswa pele ka ID ya yona mohloding, ebe ka lebitso. Phetoho ya moralo ya lehae e dula e le teng ho fihlela mohlodi o fetola moralo wa taba eo, mme ho amahanya ha pele ha ho ke ho tlosa moralo.
activity-recovery-description: Ditsebiso tse sa phethwang di lekuwa hape ka boiketsetso. Hlahloba diketsahalo tse siyo kapa tse fetohileng pele o leka hape. Ho leka hape ha ho ke ho theha ketsahalo hape.
activity-recovery-empty: Ha ho ditsebiso tsa diketsahalo tse emetseng.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Ha ho a kgoneha ho kenya ditsebiso tsa diketsahalo tse emetseng.
activity-recovery-retrying: Ho ntjhafatswa ho romelwa ha ditsebiso…
activity-recovery-status-processing: Pehelo ya ho romela e ntse e sebetsa
activity-recovery-status-missing: Ketsahalo ya pele ha e yo
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Metadata ya ho busetsa ha e a nepahala
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Moralo le ketsahalo e emetseng ha di tsamaellane
activity-recovery-busy: Tshebetso e nngwe e sebetsana le tsebiso ena. Ntjhafatsa mme o leke hape.
activity-recovery-denied: Tumello ya moamohedi kapa dikgetho tsa ditsebiso ha di sa dumella ho romelwa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Ketsahalo ya pele ha e yo kapa e fetohile. Ha ho letho le thehilweng hape.
activity-recovery-failed: Ha ho a kgoneha ho phetha ho romelwa ha tsebiso. Mosebetsi o emetseng o bolokilwe.
activity-recovery-paused: Ho romelwa ha ditsebiso tsa diketsahalo ho emisitswe nakwana.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Tsebiso ena e fetohile ho tloha ha e ne e kenngwa. Hlahloba boemo bo ntjhafaditsweng pele o leka hape.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ha ho a kgoneha ho netefatsa peakanyo ya ho romela. Ntjhafatsa mme o hlahlobe boemo ba yona ba jwale.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Ho romelwa ha tsebiso ya ketsahalo ho hlakotswe.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Hlakola ka ho sa feleng ho romelwa ho setseng bakeng sa ketsahalo ena? Sena se ke ke sa tswellwa hape. Diimeile tse seng di beilwe moleng le ditsebiso tse seng di fihlile ha di kgutliswe.
rule-email-recovery-heading: Ho fihla ha liimeile tsa melao
rule-email-recovery-description: Hlahloba liteko tse tlalehiloeng tsa ho romela liimeile tsa melao. Liteko tse sa netefatsoang li ka 'na tsa be li ntse li romela kapa li ile tsa sitisoa. Tlaleho ena ha e leke ho romela hape ebile ha e hlakole ho romela.
rule-email-recovery-sent: E amohetsoe ke seva ea imeile
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Lintlha tse hlalosang teko ha lia nepahala
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Dikhoutu tse khethollang taelo / pitso / teko
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ha ho liteko tsa ho romela liimeile tsa melao tse lumellanang le patlo ena.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ha ho a kgoneha ho kenya diteko tsa imeile tsa melao. Ntjhafatsa ho leka hape.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ha e ke e romela hape ka bo eona imeile e sa netefatsoang. Ho romela hape ho ea feela ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang. E tšoaee e rometsoe haeba u tseba hore e fihlile, kapa u hlakole ho romela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ho romela ha pele ho ka 'na ha tsoela pele. U ka etsa qeto ka mor'a __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resends: Ho romela hape ha nakong e fetileng: __count__
rule-email-recovery-resend: Romela hape ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Romela imeile ena hape ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang? Motho eo seva ea hae ea imeile e amohetseng molaetsa ntle le ho tsebisa WeKan o tla o fumana habeli.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Tšoaea imeile ena e rometsoe ho bohle? Etsa sena feela haeba u tseba hore e fihlile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Hlakola ho romela imeile ena? E ke ke ea romeloa ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ho romela ha pele ho ka 'na ha tsoela pele. Leka hape hamorao.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Imeile ena e se e rarollotsoe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ho romela hape ha pele ho ka 'na ha tsoela pele. Leka hape hamorao.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Baamoheli bohle ba se ba netefalitsoe. Ho e-na le ho romela hape, e tšoaee e rometsoe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ea imeile ha ea araba. Molaetsa o rometsoeng hape o ka 'na oa fihla kapa oa se fihle; o bontšoa o ntse o tsoela pele.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Motsamaisi e mong o ntse a rarolla imeile ena. Leka hape haufinyane.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeile e bolokiloeng ha e sa lumellana le teko ena, kahoo e ke ke ea rarolloa mona.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekoto e bolokiloeng ea teko ena ha e nepahetse, kahoo e ke ke ea rarolloa mona.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imeile ena ha ea ka ea rarolloa. Khatholla leqephe 'me u leke hape.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo
rule-email-legacy-description: Liimeile tsena tsa melao li lokisitsoe ke mofuta oa khale oa WeKan o sa ngolang hore litaba tsa tsona li tsoa hokae, kahoo WeKan e ke ke ea li romela ka bo eona. Ka mor'a ho hlahloba hore mongoli oa molao o ntse a e-na le tokelo ea ho kena, hokahanya imeile hape hore e lokisoe bocha ho latela boemo ba karete ba hona joale, kapa u e lahle.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Lintlha tsa karete tsa mofuta oa khale
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lokisa imeile ena hape ho latela boemo ba karete ba hona joale? Litaba tsa eona li ka fapana le tse lokisitsoeng pele.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla imeile ena? E ke ke ea romeloa le ka mohla.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Ha ho liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo ha lia ka tsa laeloa. Khatholla leqephe ho leka hape.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mongoli oa molao ha a sa na tokelo ea ho kena kareteng ena, kapa molao o fetohile, kahoo imeile e ke ke ea hokahanngoa hape. U ka e lahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ketso e bakileng imeile ena e fetohile, kahoo e ke ke ea hokahanngoa hape. U ka e lahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Karete eo imeile ena e tsoang ho eona ha e sa fumaneha, kahoo e ke ke ea hokahanngoa hape. U ka e lahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ts'ebetso ea molao e lokisitseng imeile ena ha e sa bolokiloe, kahoo e ke ke ea hokahanngoa hape. U ka e lahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeile ena e se e rometsoe, ho se ho lekiloe ho e romela, kapa e lahliloe.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeile ena e se e hokahantsoe hape.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ketso ena ha ea ka ea phethoa. Khatholla leqephe 'me u leke hape.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Diketso tsa ho amahanya manane tse ke keng tsa phetwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Ketso ka nngwe ho tsena tse bolokilweng tsa ho amahanya manane e ile ya ema e eso qete mme ha e sa kgona ho phethwa, hobane lenane la yona le tlositswe, le thehilwe hape kapa dipeakanyo tsa lona di fetotswe, kapa mosebedisi ya e qadileng o lahlehetswe ke tumello ya ho ngola. Ha ketso e ntse e emetse, lenane leo le ke ke la amahanngwa. Lahla ketso ho dumella lenane ho amahanngwa hape: diphetoho tse seng di sebedisitswe di sala, diphetoho tse setseng tse bolokilweng ha di ngolwe le ka mohla, mme ho amahanya ho latelang ho bapisa lenane le mohlodi wa lona hape.
stuck-sync-operation-applied: Diphetoho tse __applied__ ho tse __total__ di sebedisitswe
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Lenane le tlositswe, le thehilwe hape kapa dipeakanyo tsa lona tsa ho amahanya di fetohile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Mosebedisi ya e qadileng ha a sa na tumello ya ho ngola lenaneng lohle
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: E bolokilwe ke mofuta wa pejana wa WeKan ntle le se e qadileng
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Rekoto ya ya e qadileng ha e yo
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: Ha ho a kgoneha ho hlahloba hona jwale
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: E se e ka phetwa hape mme e tla iphethela, kahoo e ke ke ya lahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lahla ketso ena e bolokilweng ya ho amahanya lenane? Diphetoho tseo e seng e di sebedisitse di sala; tse setseng ha di ngolwe le ka mohla. Lenane le ka amahanngwa hape kamora moo.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Ha ho diketso tsa ho amahanya manane tse emetseng tlhahlobo.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ho bontshwa feela tse 50 tsa kgale ka ho fetisisa. Lahla tse ding mme o ntjhafatse ho bona tse ding hape.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ha ho a kgoneha ho kenya diketso tsa ho amahanya manane. Ntjhafatsa ho leka hape.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Ketso ena ha e sa emetse.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Ketso ena ha e a fumanwa e kgomaretse, kahoo e ke ke ya lahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Ketso ena e se e ka phetwa hape mme e tla iphethela, kahoo ha e a lahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Lenane lena le ntse le amahanngwa hona jwale. Leka hape kamora nakwana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ketso ena ha ea ka ea phethoa. Khatholla leqephe 'me u leke hape.
interrupted-import-heading: Ho kenya diboto ho emeng pele ho phethwa
interrupted-import-description: Ketso ka nngwe ho tsena tsa ho kenya boto e ile ya ema e eso qete — seva e qadile hape, kapa ho kenya ho hlolehile — mme ya siya boto e sa fellang. Ho kenya ho ke ke ha tswellwa, hobane faele ya mohlodi ha e bolokwe. Boloka boto kamoo e leng kateng, kapa o e lahle mme o kenye faele hape. Ho lahla ho tlosa boto e thehilweng ke ketso ena ya ho kenya le tsohle tse ho yona, ho kenyelletswa tsohle tse kentsweng ho yona ho tloha ka nako eo.
interrupted-import-state-stopped: E eme e sa phethwa, ho __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: E ntse e lahlwa; lahla hape ho qeta
interrupted-import-scrum: Mohato wa yona wa Scrum o na le sebaka sa wona sa ho tswella (__state__, mohato wa __next__ ho e __total__). Ha o boloka boto, phetha kapa lahla mohato oo ho tswa karolong ya ho busetsa ho kenya Scrum ya boto.
interrupted-import-counts: Ditsela tse __swimlanes__, manane a __lists__, dikarete tse __cards__, manane a tlhahlobo a __checklists__, ditshwaelo tse __comments__, diphuthelwana tse __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Boloka boto ena e sa fellang kamoo e leng kateng? Ha ho letho le tloswang, mme ketso ya ho kenya ha e sa thathamiswa mona.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lahla ketso ena ya ho kenya? Boto eo e e thehileng le tsohle tse ho yona di tloswa ka ho sa feleng.
interrupted-import-empty: Ha ho diketso tsa ho kenya diboto tse sitisitsweng tse emetseng tlhahlobo.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ho bontshwa feela tse 50 tsa kgale ka ho fetisisa. Boloka kapa lahla tse ding mme o ntjhafatse ho bona tse ding hape.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ha ho a kgoneha ho kenya diketso tsa ho kenya diboto tse sitisitsweng. Ntjhafatsa ho leka hape.
interrupted-import-missing: Ketso ena ya ho kenya ha e sa rekotilwe.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Ketso ena ya ho kenya ha e sa emetse qeto.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Boto e nang le ID ena ha e a thehwa ke ketso ena ya ho kenya, kahoo ha e a angwa.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Mohato wa yona wa Scrum o ntse o ngolwa kapa o busetswa. Leka hape kamora metsotso e mmalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Ketso ena ha ea ka ea phethoa. Khatholla leqephe 'me u leke hape.
saml-login-not-started: Ho kena hona ka SAML ha hoa qalisoa tabeng ena ea sebatli. Ka kopo, kena hape.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva ha e so netefatse ho etsolla phetoho ea hao ea ho qetela.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva ha e so netefatse ho etsa phetoho ea hao ea ho qetela hape.
history-request-hint: Ho leka hape ho pheta kopo e tšoanang, kahoo ho ke ke ha etsolla phetoho ea bobeli.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ho etsolla, ho etsa hape kapa ho busetsa diphetoho tsa Scrum ho eme ka lebaka la kgohlano. Ho hlophisa Scrum botong ena ho thibetswe ho fihlela e rarollwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Diphetoho tse __applied__ ho tse __total__ di ngotswe, tse __pending__ ha di a ngolwa, mme tse __conflicted__ di fetotswe ke motho e mong ho tloha ka nako eo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ho busetsa morao ho busetsa rekoto ka nngwe e fetotsweng kamoo e neng e le kateng; kgetho ena e fumaneha feela ha ho se motho e mong ya fetotseng direkoto tseo ho tloha ka nako eo. Ho boloka boto kamoo e leng kateng ho tlosa ketso e emeng mme ha ho fetole direkoto. Ka tsela efe kapa efe, ho rekotwa ho Phanele ya Molaodi, Mathata, Ho busetsa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Boloka boto kamoo e leng kateng
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Boloka rekoto ka nngwe kamoo e leng kateng hona jwale, ho kenyelletswa diphetoho tseo ketso e emeng e seng e di ngotse?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Molaodi wa boto a ka e busetsa morao kapa a boloka boto kamoo e leng kateng.
header-login: Ho kena ka lihlooho tsa HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Tlosa boleng bo bolokiloeng phaneleng ea motsamaisi
login-setting-after-restart: E sebetsa ka mor’a hore WeKan e qaloe hape
login-setting-env-only: Ke tikoloho ya seva feela e behang tsena. Di bontshwa mona bakeng sa ho bala feela.
email-to-card-description: Imeile e romelwang atereseng ya boto ya hao e fetoha karete botong eo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook e kenang ya mofani wa imeile (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kapa sefetisi sa melaetsa ya MIME e sa fetolwang)
email-to-card-secret-saved: E bolokilwe - e tlohele e se na letho ho e boloka
email-to-card-clear-secret: Tlosa sephiri sa webhook se bolokilweng
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Mabokose a poso a IMAP a lokelang ho balwa
email-to-card-imap-after-seen: E tshwaye e le e badilweng
email-to-card-add-imap: Kenya lebokose la poso la IMAP
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Aterese ya imeile ya grain ena
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Boto eo imeile e romelwang grain ena e yang ho yona
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Ha ho letho - feela diimeile tse nang le letshwao la boto sehloohong
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Kenya sena sehloohong ho fihla botong ena ka lebitso la hao:
email-to-card-parts: Dikarolo tsa imeile tse lokelang ho sebediswa
email-to-card-part-description: Dikahare tsa imeile e le tlhaloso ya karete
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Tlohela melaetsa ya pele e qotsitsweng
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Mola wa moromedi qalong ya tlhaloso
email-to-card-your-address: Aterese ya hao ya imeile bakeng sa boto ena
email-to-card-address-private: E boloke e le lekunutu: mang kapa mang ya nang le yona a ka kenya dikarete ka lebitso la hao.
email-to-card-new-address: Aterese e ntjha (ya kgale e kgaotsa ho sebetsa)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Diaterese tsa ka tsa diboto di a sebetsa
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Ho amohela diimeile ha ho a hlophiswa Phaneleng ya motsamaisi.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Molaodi wa boto ha a so bulele imeile bakeng sa boto ena.
email-to-card-off-member-off: O timme diaterese tsa hao tsa diboto ho Ditlhophiso tsa setho.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ha e so be le aterese ya yona ya imeile. Kenya leqephe hape.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: O hloka tumello ya ho ngola botong ena.
inbound-domain-invalid: Seo hase lebitso la domeine le nepahetseng.
inbound-domain-required: Fana ka domeine ya diaterese tsa diboto.
inbound-account-invalid: Lebokose la poso la IMAP le hloka lebitso la seva le nepahetseng.
feature-views-email-desc: Boto e le lebokose la mangolo: lenane la imeile ke Tse kenang, manane ke difoldara, dileibole ke dileibole, mme ditho di ngola le ho araba diimeile ho tswa atereseng ya boto.
email-view-not-receiving: Boto ena ha e so amohele diimeile. E bulele ho Ditlhophiso tsa ditsebiso tsa boto → Imeile ho karete.
email-view-invalid-address: E nngwe ya diaterese hase aterese e nepahetseng ya imeile.
email-view-no-recipient: Kenya bonyane moamohedi a le mong.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Molaetsa o le mong o ka ba le baamohedi ba sa feteng 20.
email-view-too-many: Diimeile tse ngata haholo di rometswe hora e fetileng. Leka hape hamorao.
email-view-no-list: Boto e hloka lenane bakeng sa imeile.
email-view-send-failed: Imeile ha e a kgona ho romelwa.
feature-views-chat-desc: Boto e le sebaka sa puisano: dibaka tsa mosebetsi, diboto, ditsela, manane le dikarete jwalo ka sefate sa dikanale, karete bohareng le maikutlo a yona jwalo ka melaetsa ya puisano.
chat-view-pick-card: Kgetha karete dikanaleng ho e bona mona.
chat-view-no-messages: Ha ho so be le melaetsa. Ngola wa pele.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Boto e le sesupi sa mathata sa GitHub kapa Gitea: dikarete e le mathata, dileibole le dintlha tsa bohlokwa, maikutlo e le moqoqo, tse kopantsoeng e le difaele, le nalane ya boto le ho etsolla.
vcs-sort-comments-desc: Tse nang le maikutlo a mangata
vcs-no-due-date: Ha ho letsatsi la ho qetela
vcs-no-issues: Ha ho mathata a tsamaellanang le patlo ena.
vcs-no-milestones: Ha ho dintlha tsa bohlokwa hajwale. Leibole e nang le letsatsi la ho qetela ke ntlha ya bohlokwa.
vcs-no-list: Boto ena ha e na lenane kapa tsela bakeng sa bothata.
card-qr-code-desc: E skene ho bula karete ena mohaleng kapa thebleteng.
card-qr-code-too-long: Lehokela la karete ena le lelelele haholo bakeng sa khoutu ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Ha ho wiki hajoale. Ho kenya mokgatlo wa GitHub ho tlisa wiki ya polokelo mona.
github-org-import-desc: Polokelo e nngwe le e nngwe ya mokgatlo kapa ya mosebedisi e fetoha boto ya yona, e butsweng ho Board View / Version Control: mathata a yona le maikutlo, dileibole le difaele tsa ona, diphatlalatso tsa yona, mesebetsi ya GitHub Actions jwalo ka Melao, le wiki ya yona.
github-org-import-token-hint: E a hlokahala bakeng sa dipolokelo tsa poraefete le moedi o phahameng wa API. E sebediswa feela ha ho kenya ho ntse ho tswela pele mme ha e bolokwe le ka mohla.
github-org-import-issues: Mathata, le maikutlo, dileibole le difaele
github-org-import-release-files: Difaele tsa diphatlalatso (di ka ba kgolo)
github-org-import-actions: Mesebetsi ya GitHub Actions jwalo ka Melao
github-org-import-result: Mathata a %s, diphatlalatso tse %s, melao e %s, maqephe a wiki a %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Ngola lebitso la mokgatlo kapa la mosebedisi, kapa aterese ya ona ya GitHub.

optional-apis-desc: Di-REST API tse nang le sebopeho sa di-API tsa ditsamaiso tse ding tsa ho sala morao mesebetsi, e le hore di-app le di-script tsa tsona di kgone ho sebedisa WeKan ena e le backend ya tsona: seo di se bolokang se bolokwa ho WeKan, ho diboto tsa WeKan. E nngwe le e nngwe e tingwa ho fihlela e tshwauwa mona. Ha ho le e nngwe e nang le ditokelo tsa yona: moreki (client) o kena ka token ya API ya WeKan mme a ka bona le ho fetola feela seo motho eo a ka se bonang le ho se fetola ho WeKan. Kaofela di hloka hore WeKan REST API e bulehe (WITH_API=true). Aterese e ka tlase ho e nngwe le e nngwe ke yona eo moreki a e sebedisang e le seva ya hae.
optional-api-trello-desc: Di-app le di-script tse ngoletsweng REST API ya Trello (mohlala Trellinator) di sebetsa le WeKan: diboto, manane, dikarete, dileibole, litho, maikutlo le manane a ho hlahloba. Token ya Trello ke token ya API ya WeKan. Ho hlakola karete ho e isa polokelong ho WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Bareki ba REST API v2 ya Jira ba sebetsa le WeKan: projeke ke boto (senotlolo sa yona ke senotlolo sa boto), bothata ke karete (DEV-7), boemo ke lenane, mme phetoho e tsamaisa karete. Patlo e amohela JQL e bonolo: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text le ORDER BY. Kena ka token ya API ya WeKan e le phasewete. Ho hlakola bothata ho bo isa polokelong.
optional-api-github-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya GitHub bakeng sa mathata ba sebetsa le WeKan: polokelo ya khoutu (repository) ke boto, bothata ke karete, le dileibole, dintlha tsa bohlokwa (dileibole tse nang le letsatsi la ho fela), maikutlo, le e butsweng kapa e kwetsweng jwalo ka ho Pono ya boto / Taolo ya mefuta. Token ke token ya API ya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya Gitea le Forgejo bakeng sa mathata ba sebetsa le WeKan ka tsela e tshwanang le API e tsamaellanang le GitHub: polokelo ya khoutu ke boto mme bothata ke karete. Token ke token ya API ya WeKan.

email-bounces-description: Seo WeKan e se etsang ka li-imeile tse khutlang: aterese e ngotsoeng hampe, lebokose le tletseng, karabo ea ho se be teng, tletlebo ea spam. Mofuta o mong le o mong o na le liketso tsa oona, tse etsoang ha o khutlile makhetlo a kalo.
email-bounces-enabled: Laola li-imeile tse khutlileng ho WeKan
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aterese ha e eo: phoso ea ho ngola, ak'haonte e hlakotsoeng, domeine e sa tsejoeng.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ha e so fihle hajoale: lebokose le tletse, seva e phathahane. Tse ngata tse latellanang feela li bolela ho hong.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Likarabo tsa ho se be ofising, phomolo kapa sistimi ea litekete. Imeile e fihlile.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Moamoheli o tšoaile imeile e le spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ho Amazon SES, romela litsebiso tsa Bounce le Complaint, le molao oa kamohelo bakeng sa aterese eo WeKan e romelang ho tloha ho eona, ho sehlooho sa SNS, 'me u ngolise aterese ena ho sona ka HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Li-ARN tsa lihlooho tsa SNS tse amoheloang, e le 'ngoe moleng ka mong
email-bounces-stopped-only: Feela liaterese tseo WeKan e sa li romelleng li-imeile
email-bounces-clear-hint: Lebala ho khutla ha aterese ena 'me u e romelle li-imeile hape
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Seo hase ARN ea sehlooho sa SNS.

email-bounces-providers-description: Haeba WeKan e romela ka e 'ngoe ea litšebeletso tsena, e bulele, fa tšebeletso aterese ena ea webhook bakeng sa liketsahalo tsa eona tsa li-imeile tse khutlileng le litletlebo tsa spam, 'me u khomarele mona senotlolo seo e li saenang ka sona, kapa phasewete eo u e kentseng atereseng joaloka https://user:password@… kapa ?secret=…
email-bounces-provider-key: Senotlolo sa ho saena sa webhook
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tšebeletso e buletsoeng e hloka senotlolo sa eona sa ho saena kapa phasewete.
